prompt_input:
Create a photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 5 seconds. A cheerful young Chinese woman wearing a light beige apron stands in a beautiful modern Chinese home kitchen, holding a stainless steel cooking pot. She looks directly into the camera, smiles, slightly lifts the pot, and points at it.

She clearly speaks Mandarin Chinese with accurate pronunciation: "锅，Guō！"

Add large clean on-screen educational text:
"锅 (Guō) = Panci"

Natural facial expressions, realistic human movements, accurate lip synchronization, cinematic lighting, professional educational TikTok style. Camera medium close-up, smooth subtle push-in. No cartoon, no animation, no watermark.
prompt_final:

The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed throughout the shot. She looks directly into the camera and smiles warmly, then slightly lifts the stainless steel cooking pot in her hands toward the lens and points at it with a friendly, teaching gesture. She clearly speaks Mandarin Chinese with accurate pronunciation and precise lip synchronization: <d>[Chinese] 锅，Guō！</d> Large clean educational on-screen text appears legibly on screen: "锅 (Guō) = Panci".
